raw_resume.summary: Software Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience building scalable Java and Spring Boot microservices for fintech payments. Seeking the Software Development Engineer II role to deepen expertise in distributed systems architecture and design patterns.

bullets: Reduced p95 latency of the settlement API from 800 ms to 350 ms by adding Redis caching.
Split the monolithic payouts module into 4 Spring Boot microservices communicating over REST.
Mentored 2 junior engineers and conducted code reviews in 2-week Agile sprints.
Implemented JPA/Hibernate repositories and MySQL schema changes for the merchant onboarding service.
Automated nightly reconciliation reports, saving the operations team 6 hours per week.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with distributed systems concepts (consensus, eventual consistency, CAP theorem) and document them in a project or role description.
Study and apply common design patterns (Factory, Observer, Strategy, Circuit Breaker) in your microservices work, then highlight pattern usage in your resume.
Deepen algorithmic problem-solving skills through competitive programming or system design interviews; mention complexity analysis in future role descriptions.
raw_resume.growth_note: You meet the 3+ years professional experience requirement and have strong microservices and backend fundamentals. However, the JD emphasises distributed systems, algorithms, and design patterns as core competencies. Your resume currently demonstrates only code review from the curated keywords. To strengthen your candidacy, gain explicit experience with distributed system design (e.g., sharding, replication, consensus) and document algorithmic or design-pattern work in your next role.
